camel_example: aliyun live ListEdgeTranscodeTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --Type 'nbhd-2' --PageSize 20 --Keyword baseline --ClusterId '0000003b-4d18-395c-8106-ff21a6000000' --SortBy desc --PageNo 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --VideoCodec 'H.264'
description_en: Queries the list of edge transcoding templates
description_zh: 查询边缘转码模板列表
kebab_example: aliyun live list-edge-transcode-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id 0000003b-4d18-395c-8106-ff21a6000000 --type nbhd-2 --video-codec H.264 --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --sort-by desc --keyword baseline --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEdgeTranscodeTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The edge transcoding type. Valid values:
common: default transcoding (standard + Narrowband HD 1.0).
nbhd-2: Narrowband HD 2.0.
ultra-hd: ultra-high definition.

If this parameter is not specified, the system displays transcoding templates for the transcoding types that the user has permissions to access
parameters.help_zh:
边缘转码类型，枚举：
common 通用（普通+窄带高清1.0）。
nbhd-2 窄带高清2.0。
ultra-hd 超高清。

当该参数不填写时，系统会展示用户拥有的转码类型权限的转码模板
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The video encoding format. Valid values:
H.264.
H.265.

If this parameter is not specified, the system displays transcoding templates for the video encoding formats that the user has permissions to access
parameters.help_zh:
视频编码格式，枚举：
H.264。
H.265。

当该参数不填写时，系统会展示用户拥有的视频编码格式权限的转码模板
parameters.name: video_codec

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为10，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting rule. Templates are sorted by creation time (CreateTime). Default value: desc. Valid values:
desc: descending order.
asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序规则，按模板创建时间（CreateTime）排序。默认是desc，枚举：
desc 降序排序。
asc 升序排序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The search keyword. Valid values:
Template ID. Exact match is supported.
Template name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh:
搜索关键词，枚举：
模板ID，模板ID支持精确匹配。
模板名称，模板名称支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: keyword

Template.description_en: The list of edge transcoding templates

items.description_en: The list of edge transcoding templates

Bitrate.description_en: The bitrate configuration. Two modes are supported: fixed bitrate and bitrate following source (ws)
Bitrate.description_zh: 码率配置，有固定码率，码率随源（ws）2种

Codec.description_en:
The video encoding format. Valid values:
H.264.
H.265
Codec.description_zh:
视频编码格式，枚举：
H.264。
H.265

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the template was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreateTime.description_zh: 模板创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

Fps.description_en: The frame rate configuration. Two modes are supported: fixed frame rate and frame rate following source (ws)
Fps.description_zh: 帧率配置，有固定帧率，帧率随源（ws）2种

Gop.description_en: The keyframe configuration. Three modes are supported: frame-based, second-based, and keyframe following source (ws)
Gop.description_zh: 关键帧配置，有按帧配置，按秒配置，关键帧随源（ws）3种

Resolution.description_en:
The resolution configuration. Two modes are supported: fixed resolution and resolution following source (ws).
When a fixed resolution is used, if width/height is set to -1/-2, the width/height is adaptive
Resolution.description_zh:
分辨率配置，有固定分辨率，分辨率随源（ws）2种。
当使用固定分辨率时，width/height取值为-1/-2，则表示宽/高自适应
